selection_rule: For each outer fold and family independently: mean of 2 inner folds x all3 seeds; maximize Macro-F1 then BalancedAccuracy then Accuracy then profile ID; no outer selection. Coupled profiles are not a factorial grid or independent-factor ablation.

fixed_preprocessing.alpha: per-spectrum SNV ddof1 then current-source StandardScaler
fixed_preprocessing.time: fixed per-spectrum consecutive-block means to512 then source StandardScaler
fixed_preprocessing.frequency: fixed per-spectrum consecutive-block means to256 then source StandardScaler

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.checkpoint_choice: final epoch fixed by selected inner profile

mcuve: unchanged original MCUVESelector, fit only current training rows, each internal PLS fit instrumented; noncontiguous variables passed to MLP, never direct convolution
attention: SE only in se_alpha; attention is a model mechanism, not chemical concentration

comparators.R2_scope: 821/855 historical exposed within-batch development, seed42; no weaker replacement or recomputation of old score

not_run_models.mcuve_only: implemented and boundary-tested but outside this eight-family minimum budget
not_run_models.dual_alpha_mcuve_se: implemented and boundary-tested but outside this eight-family minimum budget
not_run_models.HQ_Tianma_classification: BLOCKED unresolved physical ancestors and independent-label evidence

scientific_status: EXPLORATORY exposed single-batch development; no reserved independent confirmation dataset

file_isolation.prepare: only preparation reads full labeled DB for fixed-context packaging
file_isolation.selection: source packs contain only source y; inner truth read only for validation scoring
file_isolation.evaluation: source fitting plus label-free inference, no outer truth CSV opened
file_isolation.score: separate process joins immutable prediction rows with outer truth

source_training_gate: root release binds protocol/preparation/all source hashes after actual guard and neural tests
outer_gate: all5 outer-fold inner selections locked, root release binds lock/manifest/protocol and actual UTC
resource_limit: CPU single thread; 480inner model fits +120outer model fits, fixed2profiles; full171 pointwise inference checks per outer model
